chapter: Teddy Wilson bands and Cafe Society
title: Benny Goodman as a leader
summary: Hall found Goodman a perfect gentleman in six months of work and discusses the stories told about him.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: But I guess Benny is the kind of guy that, he always did what he wanted to do?
Well, I worked with Benny for six months
and I thought he was a perfect gentleman. I knew of the things that had been said about him but he --
Yeah. He was a hard leader, and then the "Ray" (phonetic) stories, and then of course, the eccentric stories which they all tell on him. The strange things, the absent-mindedness.
But we all have people like that that may be some way to somebody else but when it comes to you, you have to say, well, I never had any -- you know.
I know a lot of people like that. Who have reputations for this, and the other thing, and I can't say anything bad about them as far as my relationship with them.
Right. I don't think one should. You can see what relationships are happening, and sometimes you can speak up and say something.
Well, maybe it's a case where you say, well, be that as it may, my relationship with him was great.
When did you play with Benny?
